records.literal_gloss: For the director, on a stringed instrument, of David.

en.L: For the director: on a stringed instrument. Of David.
en.B: For the music director. On a stringed instrument. Of David.
en.R: For the leader of the music. To be played on a stringed instrument. By David.

decisions.choice: The title is verse 1
decisions.reason: The title is part of the Hebrew text and is counted as verse 1, so the verse numbers here are one higher than in Bibles that print the title without a number.

decisions.choice: the director
decisions.reason: As in 4:1.

decisions.choice: a stringed instrument: music played on strings
decisions.reason: As in 4:1, where the word is plural; here it is singular.

records.literal_gloss: Hear, God, my cry; pay attention to my prayer.

en.L: Hear, God, my cry; attend to my prayer.
en.B: God, hear my loud cry; pay attention to my prayer.
en.R: God, hear me when I cry out to {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}. Listen to my prayer.

decisions.choice: my cry: a loud cry of joy or of need
decisions.reason: The word (rinnah) is a ringing cry, here a cry for help (17:1).

source.text: מִקְצֵ֤ה הָאָ֨רֶץ׀אֵלֶ֣יךָ אֶ֭קְרָא בַּעֲטֹ֣ף לִבִּ֑י בְּצוּר־יָר֖וּם מִמֶּ֣נִּי תַנְחֵֽנִי׃

records.literal_gloss: From [the] end of the earth to you I call when grows faint my heart; on a rock [that] is high from me lead me.

en.L: From the end of the earth I call to {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} when my heart grows faint; to a rock [that] is higher than I, lead me.
en.B: From the far edge of the earth I call to {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} while my heart fails; lead me up onto a rock too high for me to climb.
en.R: I am far away, at the end of the earth, and I feel weak. But I call to {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}. Lead me to a high rock where I will be safe, a rock I could never climb by myself.

decisions.choice: the end of the earth: far from God's house
decisions.reason: The psalmist feels far from the sanctuary, as at the edge of the world. The phrase may also mean the edge of the underworld, near death.

decisions.choice: a rock higher than I: a safe place I cannot reach alone
alternatives: a rock that is too high for me (unless you lead me)
decisions.reason: A high rock was a place of safety from enemies (27:5). It is higher than the psalmist can climb, so God must lead him there.

decisions.choice: where I will be safe
decisions.reason: Readable says what the high rock means (m2).

source.text: כִּֽי־הָיִ֣יתָ מַחְסֶ֣ה לִ֑י מִגְדַּל־עֹ֝֗ז מִפְּנֵ֥י אוֹיֵֽב׃

records.literal_gloss: For you have been a refuge for me, a tower of strength from before [the] enemy.

en.L: For {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have been a refuge for me, a tower of strength before [the] enemy.
en.B: For {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have been my shelter, a strong tower to hold off the enemy.
en.R: You have always kept me safe. You are like a strong tower where I can hide from my enemies.

decisions.choice: refuge: a shelter to run to
decisions.reason: As in 46:2.

decisions.choice: a tower of strength: a fortified tower
decisions.reason: A tower in a city wall or on a hill was the last place of defense (Judges 9:51; Proverbs 18:10).

source.text: אָג֣וּרָה בְ֭אָהָלְךָ עוֹלָמִ֑ים אֶֽחֱסֶ֨ה בְסֵ֖תֶר כְּנָפֶ֣יךָ סֶּֽלָה׃

records.literal_gloss: Let me sojourn in your tent forever; let me take refuge in [the] shelter of your wings. Selah.

en.L: Let me sojourn in {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} tent forever; let me take refuge in the shelter of {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} wings. Selah
en.B: Let me live as a guest in {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} tent for all time; let me find refuge under the cover of {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} wings. Selah
en.R: Let me live in {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} house forever. Let me run to {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} for safety and hide under {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} wings, like a chick under its mother. Selah

decisions.choice: sojourn: live as a guest under God's protection
decisions.reason: The verb (gur) means to live as a resident guest, under the host's protection. God's tent is the sanctuary (15:1; 27:5).

decisions.choice: the shelter of your wings: God's protecting care
alternatives: the wings of the cherubim over the ark
decisions.reason: The picture is of a bird sheltering its young (17:8; 36:8; 57:2). Some see also the wings of the cherubim in the sanctuary.

decisions.choice: your house
decisions.reason: Readable says "house" for God's dwelling, as the tent means the sanctuary (m1).

decisions.choice: like a chick under its mother
decisions.reason: Readable explains the picture (m2).

decisions.choice: Selah: a word whose meaning is no longer known
alternatives: lift up (the voice or the music)
decisions.reason: Selah stands at the end of a line 71 times in the Psalms and 3 times in Habakkuk 3. It is probably a direction for singing or music, perhaps a pause or an interlude; the ancient Greek translation renders it with a word meaning "interlude". It is not part of what is said, and here it marks a break after the line.

decisions.choice: Selah, kept as it is
decisions.reason: Its meaning is unknown (see the meaning decision on Selah), so every level keeps the word rather than guess, and keeps it apart from the sentence.

source.text: כִּֽי־אַתָּ֣ה אֱ֭לֹהִים שָׁמַ֣עְתָּ לִנְדָרָ֑י נָתַ֥תָּ יְ֝רֻשַּׁ֗ת יִרְאֵ֥י שְׁמֶֽךָ׃

records.literal_gloss: For you, God, have heard my vows; you have given [the] possession of [those] fearing your name.

en.L: For {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}, God, have heard my vows; {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have given the inheritance of those who fear {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} name.
en.B: God, {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have heard the promises I made; {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have granted me the share that belongs to those who honor {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} name.
en.R: God, {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have heard the promises I made to {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}. You have given me the blessings {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} give to people who honor {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}.

decisions.choice: vows: promises made to God in prayer
decisions.reason: A vow was a promise to bring an offering or praise when God answered (22:26; 50:14). The psalmist will keep them (verse 9).

decisions.choice: the inheritance: the share God gives his people
decisions.reason: The word (yerushah) is a possession handed down, often the land; here the blessings that belong to those who fear God (16:6).

decisions.choice: me
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say who receives the inheritance; the context implies the psalmist.

decisions.choice: honor you
decisions.reason: God's name stands for God himself; Readable says "you".

source.text: יָמִ֣ים עַל־יְמֵי־מֶ֣לֶךְ תּוֹסִ֑יף שְׁ֝נוֹתָ֗יו כְּמוֹ־דֹ֥ר וָדֹֽר׃

records.literal_gloss: Days on [the] days of [the] king you will add; his years like generation and generation.

en.L: Days upon the days of the king {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} will add; his years [will be] like generation and generation.
en.B: Add days upon days to the king's life; may his years go on through generation after generation.
en.R: Give the king a long life. Let his years go on and on, through many generations.

decisions.choice: the king: Israel's king, perhaps the psalmist himself
decisions.reason: The prayer turns to the king in the third person. If David is the speaker, he prays for himself as king; later the psalm was used for every king of David's line. The ancient Aramaic translation reads "the King Messiah" here.

decisions.choice: you will add: a prayer
decisions.reason: The verb can state what God will do or ask for it; in this prayer it is a request.

decisions.choice: like generation and generation: for a very long time
decisions.reason: The words mean an unending line of years (10:6; 33:11).

source.text: יֵשֵׁ֣ב ע֭וֹלָם לִפְנֵ֣י אֱלֹהִ֑ים חֶ֥סֶד וֶ֝אֱמֶ֗ת מַ֣ן יִנְצְרֻֽהוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: May he sit forever before God; loyal love and faithfulness appoint, [that] they may guard him.

en.L: May he sit [enthroned] forever before God; appoint loyal love and faithfulness, [that] they may guard him.
en.B: May he sit on his throne in God's presence forever; let loyal love and faithfulness be appointed as his guards.
en.R: May the king rule forever with God watching over him. Let faithful love and faithfulness be his guards.

decisions.choice: sit: sit enthroned, reign
decisions.reason: For a king, to sit is to sit on the throne (2:4; 29:10).

decisions.choice: loyal love: chesed
decisions.reason: The word (chesed) is the love that keeps faith, God's commitment that does not give up (5:8). With faithfulness ('emet) it is pictured as two guards for the king (compare 40:12).

decisions.choice: appoint: assign
decisions.reason: The verb (manah) means to count out or appoint (Jonah 2:1 has God "appointing" a fish). It is a request to God.

decisions.choice: faithful love
decisions.reason: As in the earlier psalms, Readable says "faithful love" for chesed.

decisions.choice: be appointed (B); Let ... be (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable turn the request into a wish; God is the one who appoints.

source.text: כֵּ֤ן אֲזַמְּרָ֣ה שִׁמְךָ֣ לָעַ֑ד לְֽשַׁלְּמִ֥י נְדָרַ֗י י֣וֹם׀יֽוֹם׃

records.literal_gloss: So I will sing praises to your name forever, to pay my vows day [by] day.

en.L: So I will sing praises to {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} name forever, as I pay my vows day [by] day.
en.B: Then I will make music to {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} name for all time as I keep my vows day after day.
en.R: Then I will always sing praise to {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}, and I will keep my promises to {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} every day.

decisions.choice: pay my vows: keep the promises made in prayer
decisions.reason: As in verse 6 and 22:26.

decisions.choice: to you
decisions.reason: God's name stands for God himself; Readable says "you".
